lines.text: Ella Morcant (4:45 P.M.):
What’s on the agenda for the student council meeting?
Ryan Quenby (4:47 P.M.):
Budget approvals, spring event planning, and drafting the
revised constitution.
Ella Morcant (4:49 P.M.):
Got it. Are we voting on new club proposals?
Ryan Quenby (4:51 P.M.):
If time permits.
Ella Morcant (4:53 P.M.):
Well, I’ll bring the tentative membership lists and the proposal summaries.
I sure hope we get to them.
Ryan Quenby (4:55 P.M.):
We shall see. Priority is finalizing funding allocations. I’ll print the revised
budget sheets and prep the financial summary. But the funding discussion
may not take very long, so fingers crossed for the club discussion. Maria
always keeps good track of time.
Ella Morcant (4:57 P.M.):
Great! You are the finance whiz! Thanks for handling the relevant documents.
I’ll review the last meeting’s minutes and highlight pending motions.
Ryan Quenby (4:59 P.M.):
Awesome. I’ll set up the projector and check the videoconferencing
link for remote members. Let’s hope Maria brings snacks this time!
